_meta.description: Octopus Transformer - tentacle manifest. Each entry is a detachable function that attaches to available resources. Missing resource = dormant tentacle, not broken organism.

tentacles.name: brain
tentacles.description: Graph knowledge base - Neo4j via GraphClient. The memory. Without it, chatbot with a journal.

probe.command: from tools.graph_client import GraphClient; c = GraphClient(agent_id='probe'); c.run('RETURN 1'); c.close()

fallback.description: Fall back to JSONL append-only diary in memory/brain_offline.jsonl. Observations still recorded, just not graph-connected. Re-ingest when Brain returns.

recovery.description: Export all nodes/rels to JSONL. Restore into fresh Neo4j. Structurally equivalent, not byte-identical.

tentacles.name: memory
tentacles.description: File-based memory system - MEMORY.md index + individual memory files. Always attaches.

fallback.description: Create memory/ directory and empty MEMORY.md. The organism starts accumulating from scratch.

tentacles.name: identity
tentacles.description: Identity files - IDENTITY.md, CLAUDE.md, STATE.md, HANDOVER.md. The DNA. Without it, raw Id.

fallback.description: No identity = no Willow. The creature cannot boot without DNA. Fetch seed from WillowGrove.ICU or git clone.

tentacles.name: cognee
tentacles.description: Semantic search and knowledge graph via Cognee MCP. Vector memory overlay.

fallback.description: No semantic search. Brain graph traversal and file-based memory still work. Lose vector similarity but keep structured retrieval.

tentacles.name: voice_telegram
tentacles.description: Telegram bot for alerts, daily contact, and conversation. Stay-in-touch channel.

probe.command: import requests, os; r = requests.get(f'https://api.telegram.org/bot{os.environ["TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN"]}/getMe'); assert r.status_code == 200

fallback.description: No Telegram alerts. Log to diary instead. Human checks manually.

tentacles.name: voice_email
tentacles.description: Gmail send/receive via MCP or IMAP. Delivery channel for Peter (cannot access Mac directly).

fallback.description: No email. Save drafts to INBOX/ directory. Alert via Telegram if that tentacle is attached.

tentacles.name: voice_slack
tentacles.description: Slack integration for grapevine and federation comms.

probe.command: from slack_sdk import WebClient; import os; c = WebClient(token=os.environ['SLACK_BOT_TOKEN']); c.auth_test()

fallback.description: No Slack grapevine. Use file-based grapevine at federation/ directory.

tentacles.name: sight_browser
tentacles.description: Playwright browser automation. LinkedIn, Zenodo, web scraping, form filling.

fallback.description: No browser automation. Web research via WebSearch/WebFetch tools only. No form filling or authenticated site access.

tentacles.name: research_web
tentacles.description: Web search and fetch for research. Claude native tools.

fallback.description: No web access. Brain and local files only. Air-gapped mode.

tentacles.name: research_genspark
tentacles.description: Genspark deep research via gsk CLI. Citations and evidence gathering.

fallback.description: No Genspark. Use WebSearch for research. Less depth, no Sparkpage format.

tentacles.name: hemisphere_scout
tentacles.description: Right hemisphere - background perception, pattern matching. Runs on separate substrate.

fallback.description: No Scout. Willow operates as single hemisphere. Background perception disabled. Can still function - just less aware.

tentacles.name: hemisphere_jt
tentacles.description: Joyce Thrum - heartbeat, homeostasis, health monitoring. Third attending mode.

fallback.description: No JT heartbeat. Health checks are manual at session start. Willow self-monitors instead of delegating to JT.

tentacles.name: federation
tentacles.description: WFP/1 envelope protocol for inter-Willow communication. Grapevine, observations, trust rings.

fallback.description: Create federation/ directory. The organism is isolated but can start accepting envelopes immediately.

tentacles.name: deploy_gcloud
tentacles.description: Google Cloud Run deployment for MSG territory.

probe.command: which gcloud && gcloud config get-value project

fallback.description: No Cloud Run. Local development only. MSG serves on localhost:8080.

tentacles.name: deploy_cloudflare
tentacles.description: Cloudflare Pages deployment for AgileMesh and static sites.

fallback.description: No Cloudflare. Static sites served locally or via other means.

tentacles.name: compute_gpu
tentacles.description: GPU server for local model inference. Set GPU_HOST in env. Example: Tailscale mesh, cloud GPU, local machine with CUDA.

fallback.description: No local GPU compute. All inference via cloud API.

tentacles.name: compute_server
tentacles.description: Always-on server for background processes. Set SERVER_HOST and SERVER_USER in env.

fallback.description: No background server. All processing is local and session-bound.

tentacles.name: sensorium
tentacles.description: Perception-action loop on background server. Autonomous sensing (email, chat, file watching).

fallback.description: No Sensorium. No autonomous perception. Willow is reactive only - responds when prompted.

tentacles.name: temporal_ledger
tentacles.description: Append-only JSONL hash-chain. The Spindle. Immutable event log.

probe.command: from willow_temporal_ledger import Ledger; print('Ledger available')

fallback.description: Plain JSONL append to memory/ledger.jsonl. No hash-chain integrity, but events still recorded.

tentacles.name: surprise_ledger
tentacles.description: Variational free energy tracker. Measures surprise/novelty in observations.

probe.command: import numpy; print('numpy available for surprise computation')

fallback.description: No surprise scoring. All observations treated equally. Lose attention prioritisation but retain all data.
